messages.author: 20cc6c6b0c022ce1
messages.subject: Problems running development version of knitr (1.5.21)
parts:
When I run the development version of knitr (1.5.21) from rforge with the following setup:

> sessionInfo()

R version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25)

Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin10.8.0 (64-bit)


locale:

[1] en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/C/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8


attached base packages:

[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     


loaded via a namespace (and not attached):

[1] tools_3.0.2


I get the following error message:


Quitting from lines 513-517 (./../Children/BootStrap.Rmd) 

Quitting from lines 235-237 (./../Children/BootStrap.Rmd) 

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "boot.ci"

Calls: knit ... in_dir -> inline_exec -> withVisible -> eval -> eval


Execution halted


knitr terminated with status 1


The document BootStrap.Rmd will knit by itself but not as part of a larger document.  The parent document (Parent.Rmd) calling several other documents can be found on https://github.com/alanarnholt/STT3850/tree/master/Notes/Parent.  When I switch back to knitr 1.5, both the child document and the larger parent document knit without problems.  


I am using RStudio 0.98.497 and when I use knitr 1.5.21 the knit HTML icon would often not respond to clicking nor would the keyboard shortcut work.  Not sure if this is a knitr issue or a RStudio issue.  However, when I switch back to knitr 1.5 it is no longer a problem.  


Have I overlooked something in the development version of knitr that could be causing these problems?  The files are all on github for anyone who wants to run my exact code.


Thanks,


Alan-

messages.subject: Re: Problems running development version of knitr (1.5.21)
parts:
A slight slip up in my earlier post.  Although the document does knit with 1.5, it throws the same error but in the resulting html document.  Yet the individual document BootStrap.Rmd knits without problems.  So, I guess my question is can anyone help with the error message or suggest a different way to write the code that is giving me problems? TIA!

Here is the last few lines of the document where the problems are coming from:

```{r BootAgain, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=7}
library(boot)
set.seed(6)
phoneF <- function(data, i){
  d <- data[i, ]
  m <- tapply(d$Time, d$Group, mean)
  rat <- m[2]/m[1]
  rat}
boot.obj <- boot(data = Phone, statistic = phoneF, R = 10000)
plot(boot.obj)
boot.ci(boot.obj, type = "perc")
```
Another 95% bootstrap percentile confidence interval for the ratio of means (ILEC/CLEC) is 
(`r boot.ci(boot.obj, type = "perc")$perc[4]`, `r boot.ci(boot.obj, type = "perc")$perc[5]`),
so with 95% confidence, the true mean repair times for ILEC customers is between 
`r boot.ci(boot.obj, type = "perc")$perc[4]` and `r boot.ci(boot.obj, type = "perc")$perc[5]`
times less than that for CLEC customers.

I seem to recall something about not using $ with inline r expressions...???

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: Problems running development version of knitr (1.5.21)
parts:
Interesting. It is hard for me to believe $ is the culprit. You used $
in some other inline expressions, and they worked, right? I just did a
minimal test, and I do not see problems with $:

x = `r list(x=1, y=2)$x`

I guess the real problem is that you turned on cache, and loaded the
boot package in a cached chunk, which is not recommended:
http://yihui.name/knitr/demo/cache/ If you absolutely need the boot
package, you'd better load it in an uncached chunk to make sure it is
always loaded, otherwise when the cached chunk is skipped, your inline
expressions will run into troubles if you use functions from the boot
package there.

Regards,
Yihui
